title: The Plus-Size Fiancée Both Brothers Wanted
synopsis: Everyone at Aldwell University is waiting for plus-size freshman Tanya Jordan to get dumped by her rich fiancé, Ethan Cross. Their engagement is only a one-year deal meant to save her family—but everything changes when Ethan’s dangerous older brother, Leo, discovers Tanya is the girl who saved his life thirteen years ago. As Leo falls for her openly and Ethan realizes his feelings are no longer fake, Tanya suddenly becomes the woman both Cross brothers refuse to let go.
intro: Everyone at Aldwell University expects plus-size freshman Tanya Jordan to be dumped by her rich fiancé, Ethan Cross. It reads like a campus romance novel, now on screen: the engagement is only a one-year deal to save her family, until Ethan's dangerous older brother, Leo, learns Tanya is the girl who saved his life thirteen years ago. Leo falls for her openly, Ethan realizes his feelings are no longer fake, and neither brother will let her go.
why: A fake-engagement romance that turns into a real love triangle.
Tanya goes from the girl everyone expects to be dumped to the one both brothers want.
Good pick if you like campus romance, brothers as rivals and a heroine who is underestimated.

faq.q: Is The Plus-Size Fiancée Both Brothers Wanted worth watching?
faq.a: If you like fake-engagement romances and love triangles, yes. It is warm and centered on Tanya rather than revenge.
Tanya Jordan, the freshman in a one-year engagement deal; Ethan Cross, her rich fiancé; and Leo, his older brother whose life she saved thirteen years ago.
